
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(synExtra)
library(fst)
library(data.table)
library(powerjoin)
library(readxl)
library(qs2)

synapser::synLogin()

syn <- synDownloader("~/data", .cache = TRUE)
```

```{r}
klaeger_ic50s <- syn("syn51288931") |>
    read_csv()

kinomescan_kd_fits <- syn("syn69680641") |>
  read_csv()

kinomescan_classes <- syn("syn51080579") |>
    read_csv()

kinomescan_kinase_info <- syn("syn51286743") |>
    read_csv()

single_dose <- syn("syn26486828") |>
    read_csv()

chembl_kd_raw <- syn("syn52854574") |>
  read_csv()

saifudeen_kd_raw <- syn("syn77581842") |>
  read_csv()
```


```{r}
chembl_kd_all <- chembl_kd_raw |>
  mutate(across(standard_value, as.numeric)) |>
  filter(
    standard_relation == "=" |
      (standard_relation %in% c(">=", ">") & standard_value > 9000)
  )

aggregate_chembl_kd <- function(df) {
  df |>
    group_by(gene_symbol, lspci_id) |>
    # If "=" values are available for a group, only use those, ignoring
    # the ">"/">=" non-binder values
    filter(
      if (any(standard_relation == "=")) standard_relation == "=" else TRUE
    ) |>
    summarize(
      chembl_kd = quantile(standard_value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE) |>
        pmin(10000),
      chembl_kd_relation = paste(sort(unique(standard_relation)), collapse = ""),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

chembl_kd_all_agg <- chembl_kd_all |>
  aggregate_chembl_kd()

chembl_kd_no_klaeger_agg <- chembl_kd_all |>
  filter(
    pubmed_id != 29191878
  ) |>
  aggregate_chembl_kd()

```


```{r}
kinomescan_kd_fits_comp <- kinomescan_kd_fits |>
  filter(
    dataset == "original_repeat_replaced",
    !exclude_target,
    rhat < 1.01,
    classification != "discordant"
  ) |>
  transmute(
    lspci_id, name, Symbol = `Entrez Gene Symbol`,
    kd = pmin(kd, 10000),
    classification
  ) |>
  # aggregate to kinase level by taking the most potent kd per kinase
  group_by(lspci_id, Symbol) |>
  slice_min(kd, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

klaeger_ic50_comp <- klaeger_ic50s |>
  transmute(
    lspci_id, Symbol = Name,
    IC50 = pmin(IC50, 10000) |>
      pmax(min(IC50[IC50 > 0], na.rm = TRUE) * 0.5)
  ) |>
  power_inner_join(
    kinomescan_kd_fits_comp,
    by = c("lspci_id", "Symbol"),
    check = check_specs(
      unmatched_keys_left = "info",
      unmatched_keys_right = "info",
      duplicate_keys_left = "warn",
      duplicate_keys_right = "warn"
    )
  )

p <- klaeger_ic50_comp |>
  ggplot(
    # aes(value, pseudo_ic50, color = classification, shape = pseudo_ic50_relation)
    aes(IC50, kd)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.5,
    shape = 16,
    size = 1
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0("  R = ", signif(r, 2))
    ),
    x = -Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
    data = \(x) tibble(
      r = cor(log10(x$IC50), log10(x$kd), method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = "")) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = "")) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = "Kd Klaeger",
    y = "Kd Kinomescan"
  )
ggsave(
    "plots/klaeger_kd_vs_kinomescan_kd.pdf", p,
    width = 3, height = 3
)


```

Make venn diagram of overlap assayed compounds that we have information for
between Klaeger and Kinomescan

```{r}
library(ggvenn)
p <- bind_rows(
    klaeger = klaeger_ic50s |>
        select(lspci_id),
    kinomescan = kinomescan_pseudo_ic50s |>
        select(lspci_id),
    .id = "source"
) |>
    distinct() |>
    split(.$source) |>
    map("lspci_id") |>
    ggvenn(auto_scale = TRUE)
p
```

Check if there are any compounds that are particularly different between
Klaeger and Kinomescan

Also, label false positives (compared to Klaeger) and false negatives
separately

```{r}
klaeger_ic50_comp_stats <- klaeger_ic50_comp |>
    mutate(
        IC50 = pmax(IC50, min(na.omit(IC50) |> .[. > 0]) * 0.5),
        log10_ic50 = log10(IC50),
        log10_pseudo_ic50 = log10(pseudo_ic50),
        log_ic50_diff = log10_ic50 - log10_pseudo_ic50,
        diff_greater_than_1 = abs(log_ic50_diff) > 1,
        difference_class = case_when(
            log_ic50_diff > 1 ~ "FP",
            log_ic50_diff < -1 ~ "FN",
            TRUE ~ "concordant"
        )
    )
```


```{r}
stats_per_group <- function(grouped_df) {
    grouped_df |>
    summarise(
        n = n(),
        n_binding_class = sum(classification == "binding"),
        frac_binding_class = n_binding_class / n,
        n_diff_greater_than_1 = sum(diff_greater_than_1, na.rm = TRUE),
        frac_diff_greater_than_1 = n_diff_greater_than_1 / n,
        mean_log_ic50_diff = mean(log_ic50_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_log_ic50_diff = sd(log_ic50_diff, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_false_positives = sum(difference_class == "FP", na.rm = TRUE),
        n_false_negatives = sum(difference_class == "FN", na.rm = TRUE),
        frac_false_positives = n_false_positives / n,
        frac_false_negatives = n_false_negatives / n,
        .groups = "drop"
    )
}

klaeger_ic50_comp_stats_per_compound <- klaeger_ic50_comp_stats |>
    group_by(lspci_id, name) |>
    stats_per_group()
```

```{r}
library(ggrepel)
p <- klaeger_ic50_comp_stats_per_compound |>
  ggplot(aes(frac_binding_class, frac_diff_greater_than_1, text = name)) +
    geom_point() +
    # geom_text_repel(
    #   aes(label = name),
    #   data = ~.x |>
    #     mutate(name = if_else(discordant < 0.04, "", name)),
    #   min.segment.length = 0
    # ) +
    labs(
        x = "Fraction of 'binding' dose-response curves",
        y = "Fraction of pseudo IC50s with >10x difference",
        title = "Per compound"
    )

plotly::ggplotly(p)

ggsave(
    "plots/klaeger_ic50_vs_kinomescan_pseudo_ic50_differences_per_compound.pdf", p,
    width = 6, height = 4
)
```

## Saifudeen

Saifudeen Kds were fit with the same Bayesian model as the Kinomescan data
(`fit_kd_gujral.py`). `kd_log` is the natural log of the Kd in M.

```{r}
saifudeen_kd_comp <- saifudeen_kd_raw |>
  filter(
    status == "ok",
    kd_log_r_hat < 1.01
  ) |>
  transmute(
    lspci_id, Symbol = target,
    saifudeen_kd = pmin(exp(kd_log_mean) * 1e9, 10000)
  )

saifudeen_vs_kinomescan <- saifudeen_kd_comp |>
  power_inner_join(
    kinomescan_kd_fits_comp,
    by = c("lspci_id", "Symbol"),
    check = check_specs(
      unmatched_keys_left = "info",
      unmatched_keys_right = "info",
      duplicate_keys_left = "warn",
      duplicate_keys_right = "warn"
    )
  )

p <- saifudeen_vs_kinomescan |>
  ggplot(
    aes(saifudeen_kd, kd)
  ) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.5,
    shape = 16,
    size = 1
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(
      label = paste0("  R = ", signif(r, 2))
    ),
    x = -Inf, y = Inf,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
    data = \(x) tibble(
      r = cor(log10(x$saifudeen_kd), log10(x$kd), method = "pearson", use = "complete.obs")
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = "")) +
  scale_y_log10(labels = scales::label_number(big.mark = "")) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x = "Kd Saifudeen",
    y = "Kd Kinomescan"
  )

ggsave(
  "plots/saifudeen_kd_vs_kinomescan_kd.pdf", p,
  width = 3, height = 3
)
```
